notes: The page discusses decomposition and inertia groups attached to x-prime, includes two marginal qualifications, and introduces henselized local objects and an outer homomorphism. This summarizes the source and is not a proof verification.

The literal prose inertia symbol is L-shaped, whereas later displays and the upper margin use I with two bars. That source inconsistency is preserved. In (26) the right side is literally k(x-prime), with no Gamma; no expected Galois-group notation has been supplied.

Formula (27) has a closed oval under the first T and a clear two-loop infinity under the second. Zero versus circle remains unresolved. The K overmark remains uncertain; its reordered bar/tilde alternatives are not counted as a witness-C base-text change.

Formula (28) has a visible prime after the retouched x. The Greek letter case remains pi/Pi uncertain because the cap, height and feet do not jointly decide it. The separate point at the far right is retained as the formula full stop.

The cancelled Notons phrase, raised Ces constructions, and isolated cancelled de are distinct layers. The upper replacement is live, although some lower-word ascenders intersect its vicinity. The small deleted de has its own physical baseline.

The short dash after the modèle parenthesis and the two parentheses around cancelled alors are actual ink omitted by C. The latter outer arcs are distinct from the descender of que entering from the preceding line.

Both L letters in the second row of (29) show fine earlier K-like diagonals beneath heavy uprights and feet. Each earlier K is retained with doubt inside the common tilde and x index. This encoding records the overwritten letter without duplicating the shared overmark/index.

The first S of (29) and the p of pas strict are also retraced. Their current letters are readable, but no different earlier character is independently recoverable there; none is invented. The label (28) and its x index are likewise darkened without a separable earlier digit/index.

Ext is a raised insertion attached after hom, before the source E. It does not label the arrow. The hom short form has no visible stop and is not expanded to H's homom. The final clause reads dont ... de, and its quotation marks are paired ticks.

Five supplied marks resolve to their first readings: M0097, M0100, M0101, M0102 and M0103. M0098 and M0099 remain unresolved. Only the exact seven supplied M IDs appear in decisions; nested cancellation doubts receive no invented IDs.

Four collation rows depart from C's base text: one omitted dash, two overwritten K layers, and omitted parentheses in a cancellation. Resolving first readings, adding case doubt, changing the first T alternative set, and reordering the K-overmark alternatives are excluded from that count.

The whole image and both native halves were inspected once. Thirteen initial contextual crops were saved and viewed; p14 extended an unsettled margin edge, p15 examined unresolved overwritten letters and fractions in the full formula context, and p16 separated the still-unsettled cancellation arcs from the descending que stroke. No OCR, external research, other page, PDF text extraction, or TeX compilation was used.

Audit b04 and b10 are slightly taller than their initial crops so the complete tr. and fait descenders are available to the independent reader. Audit b12 starts above its initial crop so the whole inserted ext and the preceding de V-tilde) context are present. These audit rectangles are explicitly distinct from the stored crop bboxes.

Quotation ticks around groupe bout and effectif are retained as double backticks/apostrophes, not H's guillemets. H's editorial notes about the T subscripts and L retracing are not copied into the transcription.

The all-ink line count is 31: 21 main baselines (including the isolated deleted de and the wrapped lines of (29)), 7 margin baselines, 2 insertion baselines and the foliation 117. Formula labels share their display baselines. No top author page number is present.
No mathematical proof, computation or formal certificate was attempted. The checks list is intentionally empty; only source reading, placement and structural completeness were checked.
